name: Magic Stone of Astral(Lvl.5)
description:
Increases the "astral" attribute on equipment items by 1.(The attribute will be added if it does not exist)
Items with astral attributes will prevent the enchant level from being reset when it fails from enchanting.
Prevention effect is as follows
- When items with enchant level 4 fails in enchanting, the enchant level will be level 4 and the items with enchant levels 5 and above will be level 5.
(If you have used a high-quality elixir, you need to compare the difference between the current reinforcement level and the high-quality elixir reinforcement level with the reinforcement level above.)

**How To Use**
1. Open the alchemy window(Y) and choose attribute grant.
2. At the left slot of the attribute grant window place the equipment item, on the right slot place the alchemy stone, and then press the "compound" button.

**Restriction**
Can only be used when current number of astral is lower than number of immortal.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
